name: rich-blocks
description: Interactive blocks in the chat: copy boxes, checklists you tick off, colored callouts in replies, a concise response style, and completed steps kept through compaction.

responseStyle.title: Response style
responseStyle.description: concise: Claude answers short and on topic, ends with Next steps when work continues, and gives your own steps as a checklist. off: only the block and callout guidance. Takes effect in the next new conversation.
